NSCameraUsageDescription: 6pm uses the camera to read the QR codes and receipts you scan. Photos stay on your iPhone unless a receipt needs a closer look.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 6pm listens while you say a spend. Your voice goes to a speech-to-text service to be written down, or stays on this iPhone in on-device mode.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: 6pm turns what you say into an amount and a name.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: 6pm only saves your close receipt and money diary to Photos. It never looks through your library.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: 6pm saves your close receipt and money diary to Photos when you ask it to.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 6pm checks which country you are in so Travel mode can turn on by itself abroad.
